cards.title: Act Like You Belong
cards.instruction: You do not understand what is happening. Copy the confidence around you and never admit confusion.

cards.title: Choose Me
cards.instruction: Make yourself the choice over another person, plan, or obligation.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You've held the camera sideways, so I've turned mine too. Choose me for the team photo instead of Martin.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I turned it to change the battery. The team needs a wide picture.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Of course. Battery first, then wide. I'll take it exactly the way you want it.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I whistle so the children look at me. Martin catches that moment.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Naturally, eyes on the whistle. Stand beside me and do that; I'll press when they look. Choose me and we'll do it together.
